friendly_name: Drift event auto-resolution via LLM judgment
source_description: GitHub issue #362 (P1-feature). Extend handle_drift_events.py with a new 'drift interpretation' LLM judgment moment (Moment 0) that classifies each detected drift event as PROPOSED_EDIT (≥80% confidence → routes through existing tier_classification), JUDGMENT_REQUIRED (escalate to operator with specific question), or NO_CHANGE_NEEDED (auto-close with audit-ledger entry). LLM failures retry with exponential backoff (30s/60s/120s) then escalate to operator via pre-#362 issue path. One-time replay of 10+ existing [doc-audit] P3 issues on first deploy. Tier 3 standard. Cut-over immediately (no shadow mode) with config-flag rollback. Target: ≤30% operator-triage rate.
